semiconductor_relevance: High — Quatek Inc. provides precision measurement systems that are essential for semiconductor manufacturing and testing processes.
summary: Quatek Inc. specializes in electronic precision measurement systems, catering to various industries including semiconductor and nanotechnology. Their products are utilized in laboratories and factories for inspection and measurement tasks critical to semiconductor fabrication and testing.

regional_presence.China: Quatek has branch offices in multiple cities including Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing to enhance service delivery.
regional_presence.Taiwan: The company has established offices in Taipei, Hsinchu, and Kaohsiung to support its operations in the region.
